metadata.title: Group-IB TI - Enrich incident with IOC context
metadata.description: Triggered by a Microsoft Sentinel incident. Searches Group-IB Threat Intelligence for every IP, domain, URL and file hash entity on the incident and posts the matching threat intelligence records back as incident comments.
prerequisites: A Group-IB Threat Intelligence subscription with API access.
A Log Analytics workspace connected to Microsoft Sentinel.
postDeployment: 1. Authorize the Microsoft Sentinel API connection.
2. Assign the Microsoft Sentinel Responder role to the playbook's managed identity so it can add incident comments.
3. Set the GIBUsername and GIBApiKey parameters.
4. Attach the playbook to an automation rule so it runs when an incident is created.

releaseNotes.title: Rebuilt for the current Group-IB TI API
notes: Replaces the deprecated Microsoft Security Graph API implementation. Calls the Group-IB Threat Intelligence API over HTTPS Basic auth and posts results as incident comments using a managed identity.

inputs.name: Segments
inputs.value:
IP: @{items('For_Each_IP')?['properties']?['address']}
@{if(equals(length(body('Filter_Matches_IP')), 0), 'No matches in collections available to this account.', concat('Matches in ', length(body('Filter_Matches_IP')), ' granted collection(s):'))}

inputs.name: Segments
inputs.value:
Domain: @{items('For_Each_Domain')?['properties']?['domainName']}
@{if(equals(length(body('Filter_Matches_Domain')), 0), 'No matches in collections available to this account.', concat('Matches in ', length(body('Filter_Matches_Domain')), ' granted collection(s):'))}

inputs.name: Segments
inputs.value:
URL: @{items('For_Each_URL')?['properties']?['url']}
@{if(equals(length(body('Filter_Matches_URL')), 0), 'No matches in collections available to this account.', concat('Matches in ', length(body('Filter_Matches_URL')), ' granted collection(s):'))}

inputs.name: Segments
inputs.value:
Hash (@{items('For_Each_Hash')?['properties']?['algorithm']}): @{items('For_Each_Hash')?['properties']?['hashValue']}
@{if(equals(length(body('Filter_Matches_Hash')), 0), 'No matches in collections available to this account.', concat('Matches in ', length(body('Filter_Matches_Hash')), ' granted collection(s):'))}

inputs.name: Chunk
inputs.value:
@if(greater(length(items('Pack_Segments')), 29000), concat(substring(items('Pack_Segments'), 0, 28950), '
[record truncated — see Group-IB portal]'), items('Pack_Segments'))

body.message:
Group-IB TI — IOC Cross-Collection Enrichment@{if(greater(length(variables('Chunks')), 1), concat(' (part ', string(variables('PartNum')), ' of ', string(length(variables('Chunks'))), ')'), '')}
(searches across all collections granted to the integration's API key; fetches first 3 records per matched collection)

@{items('Post_Comments')}
